source.author: Rainer Maria Rilke
source.work: Letters to a Young Poet & Book of Hours
source.translator: M.D. Herter Norton & early PD translations (public domain in US pre-1929 editions)

entries.text: Be patient toward all that is unsolved in your heart and try to love the questions themselves.
entries.ref: Letters to a Young Poet, Letter 4

entries.text: Live the questions now. Perhaps then, someday far in the future, you will gradually, without even noticing it, live your way into the answer.
The only journey is the one within.
Let life happen to you. Believe me: life is in the right, always.
Perhaps all the dragons in our lives are princesses who are only waiting to see us act, just once, with beauty and courage.
The future enters into us, in order to transform itself in us, long before it happens.
You must give birth to your images. They are the future waiting to be born.
I hold this to be the highest task of a bond between two people: that each protects the solitude of the other.
entries.ref: Letters to a Young Poet, Letter 7

entries.text: The point of marriage is not to create a quick commonality by tearing down all boundaries; on the contrary, a good marriage is one in which each partner appoints the other to be the guardian of his solitude.
We need, in love, to practice only this: letting each other go. For holding on comes easily.
No feeling is final.
Let everything happen to you: beauty and terror. Just keep going. No feeling is final.
Flare up like a flame and make big shadows I can move in.
God speaks to each of us as he makes us, then walks with us silently out of the night.
Being an artist means: not numbering and counting, but ripening like the tree.
Everything is gestation and then bringing forth.
If your daily life seems poor, do not blame it; blame yourself that you are not poet enough to call forth its riches.
entries.ref: Letters to a Young Poet, Letter 1

entries.text: For beauty is nothing but the beginning of terror, which we are still just able to endure.
I am learning to see. I don't know why, everything penetrates me more deeply.
Perhaps all the dragons of our lives are princesses who are only waiting to see us once beautiful and brave.
